  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name": "Owner", "type": "person"}'


# API reference: Boards

URL: https://canvas.casualoffice.org/api/reference/boards.html

Read a board's shapes and add shapes to a board.

## Create a board block with shapes

POST /api/v1/files/{fileId}/boards (operationId createBoard, scope canvas:write)

A new board block after afterBlockId (default: the end) with the given shapes; shapes without coordinates are laid out (grid, flow or cluster). Answers the new boardId and blockId.

Parameters:
- fileId (path, string, required): The host's file id
- Idempotency-Key (header, string): 1-255 visible ASCII characters, scoped to the caller. A repeat of the same request within 24 h answers the stored result (Idempotency-Replayed: true); another request with the same key is 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a duplicate while the first runs is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS. Failed requests are not stored.

Request body (application/json), example:
{
  "afterBlockId": "blk_01m87jv4q9zr3t6y8u1i2o3p4a",
  "shapes": [
    {
      "ref": "a",
      "kind": "sticky",
      "text": "Idea"
    },
    {
      "ref": "b",
      "kind": "rect",
      "text": "Plan"
    },
    {
      "kind": "arrow",
      "from": "a",
      "to": "b"
    }
  ],
  "layout": "flow"
}

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "boardId": "bd_01m87jv4t0h5kq8r2x9w3c4d5e",
  "blockId": "blk_01m87jv4tq2w3e4r5t6y7u8i9o",
  "shapeIds": {
    "a": "s_01m87jv4t1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9",
    "b": "s_01m87jv4t1k2m3n4p5q6r7s8t9"
  },
  "created": [
    "s_01m87jv4t1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9",
    "s_01m87jv4t1k2m3n4p5q6r7s8t9",
    "s_01m87jv4t1v2w3x4y5z6a7b8c9"
  ]
}

Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), ROLE_FORBIDDEN (403), FILES_REQUIRED (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), UNAVAILABLE (503), INTERNAL (500), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID (400), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (422), IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS (409), BODY_TOO_LARGE (413), BAD_INPUT (400), NOT_FOUND (404), HOST_UNAVAILABLE (502)

Example:
curl -s -X POST "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/files/doc_1/boards" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "afterBlockId": "blk_01m87jv4q9zr3t6y8u1i2o3p4a",
    "shapes": [
      {
        "ref": "a",
        "kind": "sticky",
        "text": "Idea"
      },
      {
        "ref": "b",
        "kind": "rect",
        "text": "Plan"
      },
      {
        "kind": "arrow",
        "from": "a",
        "to": "b"
      }
    ],
    "layout": "flow"
  }'

## Read a board's shapes

GET /api/v1/files/{fileId}/boards/{boardId}/shapes (operationId readBoard, scope canvas:read)

The shapes of a board block in drawing order: kind, text, position and size, tone, and for arrows the shapes they connect.

Parameters:
- fileId (path, string, required): The host's file id
- boardId (path, string, required): Board id

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "boardId": "bd_01m87jv4t0h5kq8r2x9w3c4d5e",
  "shapes": [
    {
      "id": "s_01m87jv4t1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9",
      "kind": "sticky",
      "text": "Idea",
      "x": 0,
      "y": 0,
      "w": 180,
      "h": 120,
      "tone": "y",
      "from": null,
      "to": null
    },
    {
      "id": "s_01m87jv4t1k2m3n4p5q6r7s8t9",
      "kind": "rect",
      "text": "Plan",
      "x": 240,
      "y": 0,
      "w": 180,
      "h": 100,
      "tone": null,
      "from": null,
      "to": null
    },
    {
      "id": "s_01m87jv4t1v2w3x4y5z6a7b8c9",
      "kind": "arrow",
      "text": null,
      "x": null,
      "y": null,
      "w": null,
      "h": null,
      "tone": null,
      "from": "s_01m87jv4t1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9",
      "to": "s_01m87jv4t1k2m3n4p5q6r7s8t9"
    }
  ]
}

Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), ROLE_FORBIDDEN (403), FILES_REQUIRED (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), UNAVAILABLE (503), INTERNAL (500), NOT_FOUND (404)

Example:
curl -s "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/files/doc_1/boards/bd_01m87jv4t0h5kq8r2x9w3c4d5e/shapes" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY"

## Add shapes to a board

POST /api/v1/files/{fileId}/boards/{boardId}/shapes (operationId addShapes, scope canvas:write)

Add shapes to a board: `sticky`, `rect`, `ellipse`, `diamond`, `text` and `arrow` (`from` and `to` name other shapes by their `ref` in the same call, or by id). Shapes without `x` and `y` are laid out (`grid`, `flow` or `cluster`) below what the board already holds. `shapeIds` maps your `ref`s to the new ids.

Parameters:
- fileId (path, string, required): The host's file id
- boardId (path, string, required): Board id
- Idempotency-Key (header, string): 1-255 visible ASCII characters, scoped to the caller. A repeat of the same request within 24 h answers the stored result (Idempotency-Replayed: true); another request with the same key is 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a duplicate while the first runs is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS. Failed requests are not stored.

Request body (application/json), example:
{
  "shapes": [
    {
      "ref": "a",
      "kind": "sticky",
      "text": "Idea"
    },
    {
      "ref": "b",
      "kind": "rect",
      "text": "Plan"
    },
    {
      "kind": "arrow",
      "from": "a",
      "to": "b"
    }
  ],
  "layout": "flow"
}

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "boardId": "bd_01m87jv4t0h5kq8r2x9w3c4d5e",
  "blockId": null,
  "shapeIds": {
    "a": "s_01m87jv4t1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9",
    "b": "s_01m87jv4t1k2m3n4p5q6r7s8t9"
  },
  "created": [
    "s_01m87jv4t1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9",
    "s_01m87jv4t1k2m3n4p5q6r7s8t9",
    "s_01m87jv4t1v2w3x4y5z6a7b8c9"
  ]
}

Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), ROLE_FORBIDDEN (403), FILES_REQUIRED (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), UNAVAILABLE (503), INTERNAL (500), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID (400), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (422), IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS (409), BODY_TOO_LARGE (413), BAD_INPUT (400), NOT_FOUND (404), HOST_UNAVAILABLE (502)

Example:
curl -s -X POST "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/files/doc_1/boards/bd_01m87jv4t0h5kq8r2x9w3c4d5e/shapes" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "shapes": [
      {
        "ref": "a",
        "kind": "sticky",
        "text": "Idea"
      },
      {
        "ref": "b",
        "kind": "rect",
        "text": "Plan"
      },
      {
        "kind": "arrow",
        "from": "a",
        "to": "b"
      }
    ],
    "layout": "flow"
  }'


# API reference: Comments

URL: https://canvas.casualoffice.org/api/reference/comments.html

List comment threads, start a thread on a block or reply to one.

## List comment threads

GET /api/v1/files/{fileId}/comments (operationId listComments, scope canvas:read)

Comment threads with their messages: the block (or quote) each is on, whether it is resolved, and who wrote each message (user id and name, never an e-mail address). `resolved=false` keeps the open ones.

Parameters:
- fileId (path, string, required): The host's file id
- resolved (query, boolean): Only resolved (true) or open (false) threads

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "threads": [
    {
      "blockId": "b_01m87jv4rtkdxymn93jwtx35sk",
      "messages": [
        {
          "at": 1795550974775,
          "by": "u_42",
          "text": "Is Friday still right?",
          "userId": "u_42"
        },
        {
          "at": 1795550974778,
          "by": "u_42",
          "text": "Yes, confirmed.",
          "userId": "u_42"
        }
      ],
      "quote": "Ship on Monday.",
      "resolved": false,
      "threadId": "t_01m87jv4sqj5z6jz5q2n5zdtdw"
    }
  ]
}

Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), ROLE_FORBIDDEN (403), FILES_REQUIRED (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), UNAVAILABLE (503), INTERNAL (500)

Example:
curl -s "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/files/doc_1/comments?resolved=false" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY"

## Start a thread on a block or reply to one

POST /api/v1/files/{fileId}/comments (operationId addComment, scope canvas:comment)

Start a thread on a block (`blockId`, optionally with the `quote` it is about) or on a quote alone, or reply to a thread with `threadId`. Needs `canvas:comment`. Mentions in the text notify people as in the editor.

Parameters:
- fileId (path, string, required): The host's file id
- Idempotency-Key (header, string): 1-255 visible ASCII characters, scoped to the caller. A repeat of the same request within 24 h answers the stored result (Idempotency-Replayed: true); another request with the same key is 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a duplicate while the first runs is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS. Failed requests are not stored.

Request body (application/json), example:
{
  "text": "Is Friday still right?",
  "blockId": "b_01m87jv4rtkdxymn93jwtx35sk"
}

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "threadId": "t_01m87jv4sqj5z6jz5q2n5zdtdw"
}

Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), ROLE_FORBIDDEN (403), FILES_REQUIRED (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), UNAVAILABLE (503), INTERNAL (500), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID (400), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (422), IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS (409), BODY_TOO_LARGE (413), BAD_INPUT (400), BLOCK_NOT_FOUND (404), NOT_FOUND (404), HOST_UNAVAILABLE (502)

Example:
curl -s -X POST "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/files/doc_1/comments" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "text": "Is Friday still right?",
    "blockId": "b_01m87jv4rtkdxymn93jwtx35sk"
  }'


# API reference: Members

URL: https://canvas.casualoffice.org/api/reference/members.html

The people with access to a canvas: id, name and detail, never an e-mail address.

## People with access (id, name, detail; never e-mail)

GET /api/v1/files/{fileId}/members (operationId listMembers, scope canvas:read)

The people with access to the canvas, from your members callback and the people in the document: id, name and a `detail` line (team, title). Never an e-mail address. `q` filters by name.

Parameters:
- fileId (path, string, required): The host's file id
- q (query, string): Name filter
- limit (query, integer): 1-500

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "members": [
    {
      "id": "u_42",
      "name": "Ada Lovelace",
      "detail": "Engineering"
    },
    {
      "id": "u_7",
      "name": "Lin Chen",
      "detail": "Design"
    }
  ]
}

Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), ROLE_FORBIDDEN (403), FILES_REQUIRED (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), UNAVAILABLE (503), INTERNAL (500)

Example:
curl -s "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/files/doc_1/members" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY"


# API reference: Export and import

URL: https://canvas.casualoffice.org/api/reference/files.html

Export a canvas, import Markdown, HTML or CSV into it, and convert files without a canvas.

## Export the canvas

GET /api/v1/files/{fileId}/export/{format} (operationId exportFile, scope canvas:read)

The canvas as a file: `md`, `html`, `json` (the document JSON), `ocanvas` (the native file), `docx` or `pdf`. The host's `export_formats` decides which are allowed. Images in DOCX and PDF come only from your `callback_base` or `asset_origins`; PDF needs the operator's Gotenberg sidecar. Answers `Cache-Control: no-store`.

Parameters:
- fileId (path, string, required): The host's file id
- format (path, string, required): md, html, json, ocanvas, docx or pdf

Response 200 (application/octet-stream), example:
## Launch plan

Ship on Monday.

- [ ] Write the release notes

### Tasks

| Task | Status | Due | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Write the release notes | Doing | 2026-11-27 |  |
| Tag the release | Todo | 2026-11-28 |  |


Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), ROLE_FORBIDDEN (403), FILES_REQUIRED (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), UNAVAILABLE (503), INTERNAL (500), FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED (404/400), EXPORT_OFF (403), HOST_UNAVAILABLE (502), PDF_RENDERER_NOT_CONFIGURED (501)

Example:
curl -s "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/files/doc_1/export/md" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY" \
  -o canvas.md

## Render the canvas as read-only HTML

GET /api/v1/files/{fileId}/render (operationId renderFile, scope canvas:read)

The compact, read-only view of a canvas (LIVE-06, docs/27 §2.2 "Host surfaces") for host surfaces that cannot run the `<open-canvas>` web component, such as a chat message showing a live block: the export renderer's HTML, sanitised, served with a sandboxing `Content-Security-Policy` and `Cache-Control: no-store`. Live blocks inside are resolved for the caller (what they cannot read is a placeholder). `ETag` is the document revision.

Parameters:
- fileId (path, string, required): The host's file id
- format (query, string): html (the only format)

Response 200 (text/html), example:
<!doctype html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Q1 OKRs</title></head>
<body>
<h1>Q1 OKRs</h1>
<p>Ship the client this week</p>
</body></html>


Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), ROLE_FORBIDDEN (403), FILES_REQUIRED (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), UNAVAILABLE (503), INTERNAL (500), FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED (404/400), HOST_UNAVAILABLE (502)

Example:
curl -s "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/files/doc_1/render?format=html" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY" \
  -o out.bin

## Import Markdown, HTML or CSV into the canvas

POST /api/v1/files/{fileId}/import (operationId importFile, scope canvas:write)

Add a file's content to the canvas, after `blockId` or at the end, as one change. Send the file as the raw body (UTF-8, at most 5 MiB). Markdown and HTML become blocks (HTML keeps only safe links and images, never scripts or styles); CSV becomes one database block (the first column is the title; the others are typed number, date, checkbox, select or text, or by `types`), at most 10,000 rows and 200 columns. The format must be in the host's `[host.flags] import_formats`. The import path also takes diagrams (`format=drawio` or `excalidraw`, with `dryRun`, `page` and `boardId`) and spreadsheets (`format=xlsx` or `ods`, one Spreadsheet block) as described in the integration guide. If nobody had the file open, the answer carries the saved `version`.

Parameters:
- fileId (path, string, required): The host's file id
- format (query, string): md, html or csv
- blockId (query, string): Insert after this block
- name (query, string): CSV: database name
- types (query, string): CSV: JSON array of column types
- Idempotency-Key (header, string): 1-255 visible ASCII characters, scoped to the caller. A repeat of the same request within 24 h answers the stored result (Idempotency-Replayed: true); another request with the same key is 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a duplicate while the first runs is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS. Failed requests are not stored.

Request body (application/octet-stream), example:
## Notes

Imported from Markdown.

- First point
- Second point


Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "format": "md",
  "blocks": 2,
  "blockIds": [
    "b_01m87jw2k3m4n5p6q7r8s9t0v1",
    "b_01m87jw2k3w4x5y6z7a8b9c0d1"
  ],
  "live": true
}

Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), ROLE_FORBIDDEN (403), FILES_REQUIRED (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), UNAVAILABLE (503), INTERNAL (500), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID (400), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (422), IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS (409), BODY_TOO_LARGE (413), IMPORT_OFF (403), IMPORT_INVALID (400), IMPORT_TOO_LARGE (413), BLOCK_NOT_FOUND (404), DOC_TOO_LARGE (413), CONFLICT (409), ROOM_UNAVAILABLE (503), HOST_UNAVAILABLE (502)

Example:
curl -s -X POST "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/files/doc_1/import?format=md" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY" \
  --data-binary @notes.md

## Stateless conversion

POST /api/v1/convert (operationId convert, scope canvas:read)

Convert a file without a canvas: `from` Markdown, HTML or `.ocanvas`, `to` `ocanvas`, `md`, `html`, `json`, `docx` or `pdf`. Send the file as the raw body; the answer is the converted file. Changes nothing, so it takes no `Idempotency-Key`. Images in DOCX and PDF come only from your `callback_base` or `asset_origins`; boards become pictures.

Parameters:
- from (query, string): md, html or ocanvas
- to (query, string): ocanvas, md, html, json, docx or pdf

Request body (application/octet-stream), example:
<h1>Hello</h1><p>From <strong>HTML</strong>.</p>

Response 200 (application/octet-stream), example:
# Hello

From **HTML**.


Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), INTERNAL (500), BODY_TOO_LARGE (413), FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED (404/400), INPUT_INVALID (400), PDF_RENDERER_NOT_CONFIGURED (501)

Example:
curl -s -X POST "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/convert?from=html&to=md" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY" \
  --data-binary @page.html \
  -o canvas.md


# API reference: Automation

URL: https://canvas.casualoffice.org/api/reference/automation.html

Rules stored in a canvas and run by the server on behalf of their owner: list, save, switch on or off, test and read the run history.

## List automation rules

GET /api/v1/files/{fileId}/automations (operationId listAutomations, scope canvas:read)

The rules stored in the canvas (the `automations` root), each with whether it can run and, for date and schedule rules, `nextRunAt` (ms), plus the host's limits and the origins URL calls may reach. Anyone who can read the file can read its rules.

Parameters:
- fileId (path, string, required): The host's file id

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "rules": [
    {
      "id": "au_move",
      "rule": {
        "name": "Move done items",
        "trigger": {
          "kind": "field.changed",
          "database": "db_1",
          "field": "Status",
          "to": "Done"
        },
        "conditions": [
          {
            "field": "Owner",
            "op": "isNotEmpty"
          }
        ],
        "actions": [
          {
            "kind": "row.move",
            "to": {
              "database": "db_archive"
            }
          },
          {
            "kind": "notify",
            "people": [
              "field:Owner"
            ],
            "text": "{row.title} is done and archived"
          }
        ],
        "v": 1,
        "enabled": true,
        "ownerId": "u_lea",
        "ownerName": "Lea Fischer",
        "updatedAt": "2026-11-26T09:12:00Z"
      },
      "valid": true
    }
  ],
  "limits": {
    "maxRules": 25,
    "maxChanges": 50,
    "runsPerMinute": 60,
    "runsPerDay": 1000,
    "maxDepth": 3,
    "minIntervalMin": 15,
    "timeZone": "Europe/Berlin",
    "actions": [
      "field.set",
      "row.move",
      "todo.set",
      "todo.add",
      "comment.add",
      "notify",
      "http.post"
    ],
    "origins": [
      "https://docs.acme.example"
    ]
  }
}

Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), ROLE_FORBIDDEN (403), FILES_REQUIRED (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), UNAVAILABLE (503), INTERNAL (500), HOST_UNAVAILABLE (502), AUTOMATION_OFF (404)

Example:
curl -s "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/files/doc_1/automations" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY"

## Test run a rule

POST /api/v1/files/{fileId}/automations:test (operationId testAutomation, scope canvas:write)

What a rule (saved or not) would do on the most recent matching row, or `rowId`: the trigger, each condition and each action's effect. Changes nothing and sends nothing; costs no run.

Parameters:
- fileId (path, string, required): The host's file id
- Idempotency-Key (header, string): 1-255 visible ASCII characters, scoped to the caller. A repeat of the same request within 24 h answers the stored result (Idempotency-Replayed: true); another request with the same key is 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a duplicate while the first runs is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS. Failed requests are not stored.

Request body (application/json), example:
{
  "rule": {
    "name": "Move done items",
    "trigger": {
      "kind": "field.changed",
      "database": "db_1",
      "field": "Status",
      "to": "Done"
    },
    "conditions": [
      {
        "field": "Owner",
        "op": "isNotEmpty"
      }
    ],
    "actions": [
      {
        "kind": "row.move",
        "to": {
          "database": "db_archive"
        }
      },
      {
        "kind": "notify",
        "people": [
          "field:Owner"
        ],
        "text": "{row.title} is done and archived"
      }
    ]
  }
}

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "subject": {
    "rowId": "r_1",
    "title": "Rate limit the public API"
  },
  "trigger": "field.changed",
  "conditions": [
    {
      "index": 0,
      "field": "Owner",
      "op": "isNotEmpty",
      "holds": true
    }
  ],
  "conditionsHold": true,
  "effects": [
    "Would move the row to Archive (3 fields match)",
    "Would notify u_noor through the host"
  ],
  "changes": 1,
  "changed": false,
  "sent": false
}

Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), ROLE_FORBIDDEN (403), FILES_REQUIRED (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), UNAVAILABLE (503), INTERNAL (500), HOST_UNAVAILABLE (502), AUTOMATION_OFF (404), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID (400), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (422), IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS (409), BODY_TOO_LARGE (413), BAD_INPUT (400)

Example:
curl -s -X POST "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/files/doc_1/automations:test" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "rule": {
      "name": "Move done items",
      "trigger": {
        "kind": "field.changed",
        "database": "db_1",
        "field": "Status",
        "to": "Done"
      },
      "conditions": [
        {
          "field": "Owner",
          "op": "isNotEmpty"
        }
      ],
      "actions": [
        {
          "kind": "row.move",
          "to": {
            "database": "db_archive"
          }
        },
        {
          "kind": "notify",
          "people": [
            "field:Owner"
          ],
          "text": "{row.title} is done and archived"
        }
      ]
    }
  }'

## Automation run history

GET /api/v1/files/{fileId}/automations/runs (operationId listAutomationRuns, scope canvas:read)

The run log of the canvas, newest first: ids, trigger, result, codes and counts, never canvas text or field values; kept 30 days. Editors only (the log can name people).

Parameters:
- fileId (path, string, required): The host's file id
- rule (query, string): Only this rule
- result (query, string): done, skipped, failed or stopped
- before (query, integer): `next` of the previous page (ms)
- limit (query, integer): 1-500 (default 100)

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "runs": [
    {
      "id": "run_01jdx4k8z6qf3w",
      "fileId": "doc_8812",
      "ruleId": "au_move",
      "trigger": "field.changed",
      "result": "done",
      "errorCode": "",
      "httpStatus": 0,
      "changes": 1,
      "notified": 1,
      "depth": 0,
      "durationMs": 180,
      "at": 1795689044670
    }
  ],
  "next": null
}

Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), ROLE_FORBIDDEN (403), FILES_REQUIRED (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), UNAVAILABLE (503), INTERNAL (500), HOST_UNAVAILABLE (502), AUTOMATION_OFF (404)

Example:
curl -s "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/files/doc_1/automations/runs?rule=au_move&result=failed&before=1795680000000&limit=100" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY"

## Create or replace a rule

PUT /api/v1/files/{fileId}/automations/{ruleId} (operationId saveAutomation, scope canvas:write)

Saves a rule in the canvas. The caller becomes its owner and the rule runs on their behalf from now on (with a host key, `X-OpenCanvas-Author` names them). Checked like the editor's save: valid trigger and actions, actions the host allows, URL calls only to the host's callback origin or `[host.automation] allow_origins`, schedules not more often than the minimum, at most `max_rules`.

Parameters:
- fileId (path, string, required): The host's file id
- ruleId (path, string, required): The rule id (1-64 letters, digits, - or _)
- Idempotency-Key (header, string): 1-255 visible ASCII characters, scoped to the caller. A repeat of the same request within 24 h answers the stored result (Idempotency-Replayed: true); another request with the same key is 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a duplicate while the first runs is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS. Failed requests are not stored.

Request body (application/json), example:
{
  "name": "Move done items",
  "trigger": {
    "kind": "field.changed",
    "database": "db_1",
    "field": "Status",
    "to": "Done"
  },
  "conditions": [
    {
      "field": "Owner",
      "op": "isNotEmpty"
    }
  ],
  "actions": [
    {
      "kind": "row.move",
      "to": {
        "database": "db_archive"
      }
    },
    {
      "kind": "notify",
      "people": [
        "field:Owner"
      ],
      "text": "{row.title} is done and archived"
    }
  ]
}

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "id": "au_move"
}

Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), ROLE_FORBIDDEN (403), FILES_REQUIRED (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), UNAVAILABLE (503), INTERNAL (500), HOST_UNAVAILABLE (502), AUTOMATION_OFF (404), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID (400), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (422), IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS (409), BODY_TOO_LARGE (413), BAD_INPUT (400), RULE_INVALID (400), URL_NOT_ALLOWED (400), RULE_LIMIT (400)

Example:
curl -s -X PUT "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/files/doc_1/automations/au_move" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Move done items",
    "trigger": {
      "kind": "field.changed",
      "database": "db_1",
      "field": "Status",
      "to": "Done"
    },
    "conditions": [
      {
        "field": "Owner",
        "op": "isNotEmpty"
      }
    ],
    "actions": [
      {
        "kind": "row.move",
        "to": {
          "database": "db_archive"
        }
      },
      {
        "kind": "notify",
        "people": [
          "field:Owner"
        ],
        "text": "{row.title} is done and archived"
      }
    ]
  }'

## Delete a rule

DELETE /api/v1/files/{fileId}/automations/{ruleId} (operationId deleteAutomation, scope canvas:write)

Removes the rule from the canvas (frees a slot; switching it off does not).

Parameters:
- fileId (path, string, required): The host's file id
- ruleId (path, string, required): The rule id (1-64 letters, digits, - or _)
- Idempotency-Key (header, string): 1-255 visible ASCII characters, scoped to the caller. A repeat of the same request within 24 h answers the stored result (Idempotency-Replayed: true); another request with the same key is 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a duplicate while the first runs is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS. Failed requests are not stored.

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "id": "au_move",
  "deleted": true
}

Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), ROLE_FORBIDDEN (403), FILES_REQUIRED (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), UNAVAILABLE (503), INTERNAL (500), HOST_UNAVAILABLE (502), AUTOMATION_OFF (404), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID (400), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (422), IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS (409), BAD_INPUT (400), RULE_NOT_FOUND (404)

Example:
curl -s -X DELETE "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/files/doc_1/automations/au_move" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY"

## Switch a rule on or off

POST /api/v1/files/{fileId}/automations/{ruleId}/enable (operationId enableAutomation, scope canvas:write)

`{enabled: true}` switches a rule on and makes the caller its owner ("Run it as me" on a paused rule); `false` switches it off.

Parameters:
- fileId (path, string, required): The host's file id
- ruleId (path, string, required): The rule id (1-64 letters, digits, - or _)
- Idempotency-Key (header, string): 1-255 visible ASCII characters, scoped to the caller. A repeat of the same request within 24 h answers the stored result (Idempotency-Replayed: true); another request with the same key is 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a duplicate while the first runs is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS. Failed requests are not stored.

Request body (application/json), example:
{
  "enabled": true
}

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "id": "au_move",
  "enabled": true
}

Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), ROLE_FORBIDDEN (403), FILES_REQUIRED (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), UNAVAILABLE (503), INTERNAL (500), HOST_UNAVAILABLE (502), AUTOMATION_OFF (404), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID (400), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (422), IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS (409), BODY_TOO_LARGE (413), BAD_INPUT (400), RULE_NOT_FOUND (404)

Example:
curl -s -X POST "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/files/doc_1/automations/au_move/enable" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"enabled": true}'


# API reference: Search

URL: https://canvas.casualoffice.org/api/reference/search.html

Search across the canvases a person can open, through the host's own index, and extract a canvas's search text.

## Extract search.json

POST /api/v1/extract (operationId extract, scope canvas:read)

The `search.json` of a `.ocanvas` (or Markdown) body: the same plain-text projection every save carries, for hosts that cannot open the zip or want to re-index old files. Stateless: nothing is stored. Up to 100 MB and 2 s; comments only with `[host.search] comments = true`. Changes nothing, so it takes no `Idempotency-Key`.

Request body (application/vnd.opencanvas+zip), example:
<.ocanvas bytes>

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "v": 1,
  "title": "Sprint 42 planning",
  "blocks": [
    {
      "id": "b_9f2",
      "type": "heading",
      "path": [],
      "text": "Release 4.2"
    },
    {
      "id": "b_a10",
      "type": "todo",
      "path": [
        "Release 4.2"
      ],
      "text": "SSO set-up docs updated",
      "done": false
    }
  ],
  "databases": [
    {
      "id": "db_1",
      "title": "Sprint 42 backlog",
      "rows": [
        {
          "id": "r_1",
          "text": "Fix CSV export timeout · Marco Bianchi · In review"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "boards": [
    {
      "id": "bd_1",
      "text": [
        "Hero copy is too long on phones"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "live": [],
  "truncated": false
}

Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), INTERNAL (500), BODY_TOO_LARGE (413), NOT_OCANVAS (422), EXTRACT_TOO_SLOW (422)

Example:
curl -s -X POST "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/extract" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY" \
  --data-binary @notes.md

## Search across canvases

GET /api/v1/search (operationId search, scope canvas:read)

Searches the canvases the token's user can open, through the host's own `GET /search` callback (the host indexes `search.json`; OpenCanvas keeps no index and caches nothing). Needs a **user** token: a host key gets 400 `USER_TOKEN_REQUIRED`. Hits on files the host's `/access` refuses are dropped. At most 10 searches a minute per user. The MCP tool `canvas_search` answers the same items.

Parameters:
- q (query, string, required): The words to look for (at most 200 bytes)
- scope (query, string): A scope id the host offered
- cursor (query, string): `next` of the previous page
- limit (query, integer): Items per page, 1-50 (default 20)

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "fileId": "doc_8812",
      "title": "Sprint 42 planning",
      "path": "Engineering",
      "blockId": "b_3fQ1",
      "snippet": "Admins can sign in with SSO, and…",
      "updatedAt": "2026-11-26T09:41:00Z"
    }
  ],
  "scopes": [
    {
      "id": "all",
      "label": "All canvases"
    }
  ],
  "partial": false,
  "next": null
}

Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), BAD_INPUT (400), USER_TOKEN_REQUIRED (400), SEARCH_UNAVAILABLE (404), HOST_TIMEOUT (504), HOST_ERROR (502)

Example:
curl -s "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/search?q=SSO&scope=all&cursor=p2&limit=20" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY"


# API reference: Links

URL: https://canvas.casualoffice.org/api/reference/links.html

The canvases that link to a canvas, as a person may see them, and the host's maintenance of the link index.

## Canvases that link to this canvas

GET /api/v1/files/{fileId}/backlinks (operationId listBacklinks, scope canvas:read)

"Linked from" (ADR-081): the canvases whose last acknowledged save links to this canvas (or, with `block`, to one block of it), newest save first, 20 to a page. Needs a **user** token: a host key gets 400 `USER_TOKEN_REQUIRED`. The token's user needs view on this canvas, and every linking canvas is checked with the host (`POST /access/batch`, else `POST /access`): one the user cannot open is left out and not counted, in `items`, `total` and `blocks` alike. Titles and paths are the host's answers; excerpts are made from the linking canvas at read time and never stored. Needs `[host.flags] links`. The MCP tool `canvas_backlinks` answers the same.

Parameters:
- fileId (path, string, required): The host's file id
- block (query, string): Only links to this block id of the canvas
- kind (query, string): `link`, `embed`, `relation` or `all` (default)
- cursor (query, string): `next` of the previous page
- limit (query, integer): Linking canvases per page, 1-50 (default 20)

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "fileId": "doc_8812",
  "items": [
    {
      "fileId": "doc_7710",
      "title": "Q1 Platform roadmap",
      "path": "Engineering / Planning",
      "updatedAt": "2026-11-27T16:02:00Z",
      "updatedBy": "Jonas Weber",
      "savedAt": 1795800000000,
      "role": "edit",
      "refs": [
        {
          "block": "b_3fQ1",
          "toBlock": "b_9kP2",
          "toRow": null,
          "kind": "link",
          "section": "Identity",
          "excerpt": {
            "before": "Scope and dates live in ",
            "link": "SSO rollout plan",
            "after": "."
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "total": 1,
  "blocks": {
    "b_9kP2": 1
  },
  "next": null
}

Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), ROLE_FORBIDDEN (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), BAD_INPUT (400), USER_TOKEN_REQUIRED (400), LINKS_OFF (404), FILE_GONE (410), INTERNAL (500)

Example:
curl -s "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/files/doc_1/backlinks?block=b_9kP2&kind=link&cursor=o20&limit=20" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY"

## Drop a deleted file's links from the index

DELETE /api/v1/links/files/{fileId} (operationId deleteFileLinks)

For a file deleted in your application: its outgoing links leave the link index at once (otherwise they go the next time a read finds the file gone). Links *to* it stay until their sources are saved again; readers see them as "Deleted canvas". Host key only.

Parameters:
- fileId (path, string, required): The host's file id

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "fileId": "doc_1",
  "removed": 4
}

Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), HOST_KEY_REQUIRED (403), LINKS_OFF (404), BAD_INPUT (400), INTERNAL (500)

Example:
curl -s -X DELETE "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/links/files/doc_1" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY"

## Backfill the link index from your files

POST /api/v1/links/index (operationId indexLinks)

Loads each file through your load callback (with the host key's callback bearer), writes its outgoing links to the index and drops the document; nothing else is kept. Up to 100 files per call; run it once over your files when you turn `[host.flags] links` on. Files that are missing, fail to load or are not `.ocanvas` are listed in `failed` with `not_found`, `host_error` or `not_ocanvas`. Host key only.

Request body (application/json), example:
{
  "fileIds": [
    "doc_1",
    "doc_2"
  ]
}

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "indexed": [
    {
      "fileId": "doc_1",
      "links": 12,
      "dropped": 0
    }
  ],
  "failed": [
    {
      "fileId": "doc_2",
      "code": "not_found"
    }
  ]
}

Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), HOST_KEY_REQUIRED (403), LINKS_OFF (404), BAD_INPUT (400), INTERNAL (500)

Example:
curl -s -X POST "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/links/index" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"fileIds": ["doc_1", "doc_2"]}'

## The link graph between canvases

GET /api/v1/graph (operationId getGraph, scope canvas:read)

The knowledge graph (ADR-082) from the link index. With `root`: the canvases around it, breadth-first in both directions to `depth`. Without: the most-connected canvases of your application, up to `limit`. Every canvas is checked with your `/access/batch` (else `/access`) **before** it is shown or expanded, so a canvas the user cannot open is neither a node nor a bridge between two others. `truncated` says the walk stopped early; `total` is given only when every candidate was checked. `in` and `out` count the edges in this answer. Needs a **user** token and `[host.flags] links`; 10 graphs a minute per person, 2 of them full. Cached 30 s per person and parameters. The MCP tool `canvas_graph` answers the same.

Parameters:
- root (query, string): A file id for a local graph; absent for the full graph
- depth (query, integer): 1-3 around `root` (default 1)
- kinds (query, string): Comma-separated `link`, `embed`, `relation` (default all)
- blocks (query, boolean): Add block nodes for link targets (default false)
- limit (query, integer): Nodes: 1-500 for a local graph (default 200), 1-2000 for the full graph (default 2000)

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "nodes": [
    {
      "id": "doc_8812",
      "kind": "canvas",
      "fileId": "doc_8812",
      "title": "SSO rollout plan",
      "path": "Engineering / Identity",
      "space": "Engineering",
      "updatedAt": "2026-11-27T16:02:00Z",
      "in": 4,
      "out": 2
    },
    {
      "id": "doc_7710",
      "kind": "canvas",
      "fileId": "doc_7710",
      "title": "Q1 Platform roadmap",
      "path": "Engineering / Planning",
      "space": "Engineering",
      "updatedAt": null,
      "in": 0,
      "out": 1
    }
  ],
  "edges": [
    {
      "from": "doc_7710",
      "to": "doc_8812",
      "kind": "link"
    }
  ],
  "truncated": false
}

Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), ROLE_FORBIDDEN (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), BAD_INPUT (400), USER_TOKEN_REQUIRED (400), LINKS_OFF (404), FILE_GONE (410), INTERNAL (500)

Example:
curl -s "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/graph?root=doc_8812&depth=2&kinds=link,embed&blocks=false&limit=200" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY"


# API reference: Events and sync

URL: https://canvas.casualoffice.org/api/reference/streams.html

Stream a file's change events, and get a ticket to sync the CRDT document directly.

## Change events of one file, as Server-Sent Events or (with a WebSocket upgrade) JSON text messages

GET /api/v1/files/{fileId}/events (operationId streamEvents, scope canvas:read)

SSE: `id: <event id>`, `event: <type>`, `data: <Event JSON>`, a keep-alive comment every 15 s. WebSocket: one Event per text message. Resume with `Last-Event-ID` (or `since`): the events after it from this server's in-memory ring (512 per file), or one `resync` event when it is gone. A stream that falls 256 events behind is closed with code 4008 (SSE: a final `close` event `{code, reason}`); a user token's stream closes with 4001 when the token expires, and with 4003 when the host revokes the user. Events carry ids only, never content.

Parameters:
- fileId (path, string, required): The host's file id
- Last-Event-ID (header, string): Resume after this event id
- since (query, string): Same as Last-Event-ID (the header wins)
- types (query, string): Comma-separated event types to receive (default all)

Response 200 (text/event-stream), example:
id: ev_01m87jv4t3ggvh8n6d6nh38xc0
event: commented
data: {"at":1795550974787,"data":{"added":1,"blockId":"b_01m87jv4rtkdxymn93jwtx35sk","by":["u_42"],"threadId":"t_01m87jv4sqj5z6jz5q2n5zdtdw"},"fileId":"doc_1","id":"ev_01m87jv4t3ggvh8n6d6nh38xc0","type":"commented"}



Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), ROLE_FORBIDDEN (403), FILES_REQUIRED (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), UNAVAILABLE (503), INTERNAL (500), BAD_INPUT (400), TOO_MANY_STREAMS (429)

Example:
curl -s -N "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/files/doc_1/events?types=saved,commented" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream"

## A ticket for the room WebSocket, so a Yjs-native client syncs the CRDT directly

POST /api/v1/files/{fileId}/sync-token (operationId createSyncToken, scope canvas:read)

Answers a session ticket with the caller's effective role (min(scope, host role)). Connect to `url` (y-websocket protocol) within 60 s; the session ends at `expiresAt`. Takes no Idempotency-Key: the answer is a credential and is never stored. `Cache-Control: no-store`.

Parameters:
- fileId (path, string, required): The host's file id

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "connectWithinSecs": 60,
  "expiresAt": 1795551874,
  "role": "edit",
  "room": "r_2whbv4nncveupmqu35cywoidfe",
  "ticket": "01M87JV4T23GYQ773ZF1WN91VA",
  "url": "/v1/collab/r_2whbv4nncveupmqu35cywoidfe?ticket=01M87JV4T23GYQ773ZF1WN91VA"
}

Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), ROLE_FORBIDDEN (403), FILES_REQUIRED (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), UNAVAILABLE (503), INTERNAL (500)

Example:
curl -s -X POST "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/files/doc_1/sync-token" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY"


# API reference: Admin

URL: https://canvas.casualoffice.org/api/reference/admin.html

Host operations: save now, change a user's role live, close the session, drop cached members.

## Save now (200 saved, 202 queued in the outbox, 409 conflict)

POST /api/v1/files/{fileId}/commit (operationId commitFile, scope canvas:admin)

Save the canvas to your application now, for example before you back it up. `200` once your save callback answered (`saved: false` when there was nothing new), `202` when the save failed and waits in the outbox to be retried, `409` when your callback reported a conflict.

Parameters:
- fileId (path, string, required): The host's file id
- Idempotency-Key (header, string): 1-255 visible ASCII characters, scoped to the caller. A repeat of the same request within 24 h answers the stored result (Idempotency-Replayed: true); another request with the same key is 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a duplicate while the first runs is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS. Failed requests are not stored.

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "live": true,
  "saved": true,
  "version": "18"
}

Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), ROLE_FORBIDDEN (403), FILES_REQUIRED (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), UNAVAILABLE (503), INTERNAL (500), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID (400), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (422), IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS (409), BODY_TOO_LARGE (413), CONFLICT (409)

Example:
curl -s -X POST "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/files/doc_1/commit" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY"

## Change a user's role live (none disconnects them)

POST /api/v1/files/{fileId}/role (operationId setRole, scope canvas:admin)

Change a user's role on the file, live: their open sessions switch at once (`view` makes them read-only, `none` disconnects them and drops them from the member list). The role also applies to launch tokens issued before the call. Answers how many live connections switched and sessions were updated.

Parameters:
- fileId (path, string, required): The host's file id
- Idempotency-Key (header, string): 1-255 visible ASCII characters, scoped to the caller. A repeat of the same request within 24 h answers the stored result (Idempotency-Replayed: true); another request with the same key is 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a duplicate while the first runs is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS. Failed requests are not stored.

Request body (application/json), example:
{
  "userId": "u_42",
  "role": "view"
}

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "connections": 1,
  "sessions": 2
}

Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), ROLE_FORBIDDEN (403), FILES_REQUIRED (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), UNAVAILABLE (503), INTERNAL (500), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID (400), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (422), IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS (409), BODY_TOO_LARGE (413), BAD_INPUT (400), ROLE_INVALID (400)

Example:
curl -s -X POST "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/files/doc_1/role" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"userId": "u_42", "role": "view"}'

## Final save, disconnect everyone, drop every ticket

DELETE /api/v1/files/{fileId}/session (operationId closeSession, scope canvas:admin)

For a file deleted or moved in your application: a final save, then every connection is closed and every ticket for the file is dropped.

Parameters:
- fileId (path, string, required): The host's file id

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "closed": true,
  "sessions": 3
}

Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), ROLE_FORBIDDEN (403), FILES_REQUIRED (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), UNAVAILABLE (503), INTERNAL (500)

Example:
curl -s -X DELETE "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/files/doc_1/session" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY"

## The member list changed; drop cached answers

POST /api/v1/files/{fileId}/members:invalidate (operationId invalidateMembers, scope canvas:admin)

Tell OpenCanvas the file's member list changed outside a role call: the cached members answer is dropped and open editors fetch it again.

Parameters:
- fileId (path, string, required): The host's file id
- Idempotency-Key (header, string): 1-255 visible ASCII characters, scoped to the caller. A repeat of the same request within 24 h answers the stored result (Idempotency-Replayed: true); another request with the same key is 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a duplicate while the first runs is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS. Failed requests are not stored.

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "invalidated": true
}

Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), ROLE_FORBIDDEN (403), FILES_REQUIRED (403), RATE_LIMITED (429), UNAVAILABLE (503), INTERNAL (500), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID (400), IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (422), IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS (409), BODY_TOO_LARGE (413)

Example:
curl -s -X POST "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/files/doc_1/members:invalidate" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY"

## Revoke every offline copy of a person

POST /api/v1/offline/revoke (operationId offlineRevoke, scope canvas:admin)

Raise the person's offline generation for this host (ADR-064, docs/34 §3.6). Every device holding their offline copies deletes them, and their unsent changes, at its next session answer, which carries the new number. The server stores only this number per host and user, never content (ADR-001). Offline copies need `[host.offline] enabled`.

Request body (application/json), example:
{
  "userId": "u_123"
}

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "gen": 5
}

Errors: API_OFF (404), UNAUTHENTICATED (401), TOKEN_INVALID (401), TOKEN_EXPIRED (401), SCOPE_REQUIRED (403), BAD_INPUT (400), RATE_LIMITED (429), UNAVAILABLE (503), INTERNAL (500), BODY_TOO_LARGE (413)

Example:
curl -s -X POST "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/offline/revoke" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"userId": "u_123"}'


# API reference: OpenAPI document

URL: https://canvas.casualoffice.org/api/reference/meta.html

The OpenAPI 3.1 document this reference is generated from.

## This document

GET /api/v1/openapi.json (operationId getOpenApi)

The OpenAPI 3.1 document of this server's API, the same file as `crates/oc-server/api/openapi.json` in the repository. Public: no credentials, not rate limited.

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "openapi": "3.1.0",
  "info": {
    "title": "OpenCanvas headless API",
    "version": "1.0.0"
  },
  "paths": {}
}

Example:
curl -s "https://canvas.example.com/api/v1/openapi.json"


# API reference: 0.1 routes (deprecated)

URL: https://canvas.casualoffice.org/api/reference/legacy.html

The 0.1 host routes, kept through 0.x with their old answers, and retired in v0.3. Use the `/api/v1` successor each one names.

## Patch blocks (0.1)

POST /v1/files/{fileId}/patch (operationId legacyPatch)

0.1 route, kept through 0.x with its answers and `{error:{code,message}}` errors. Successor: `/api/v1/files/{fileId}/blocks:batch` (sent in `Link: rel="successor-version"`, with `Deprecation`).

Parameters:
- fileId (path, string, required): The host's file id

Request body (application/json), example:
{
  "ops": [
    {
      "op": "append",
      "markdown": "Shipped on Friday."
    }
  ],
  "author": {
    "id": "u_42",
    "name": "Ada Lovelace"
  }
}

Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "applied": 1,
  "blockIds": [
    "b_01m87jv4s4hw2f9n0k3q6t8y1v"
  ],
  "live": true
}

Errors: API_KEY_INVALID (401), PATCH_INVALID (400), BLOCK_NOT_FOUND (404), DOC_TOO_LARGE (413), CONFLICT (409), ROOM_UNAVAILABLE (503), HOST_UNAVAILABLE (502)

Example:
curl -s -X POST "https://canvas.example.com/v1/files/doc_1/patch" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "ops": [
      {
        "op": "append",
        "markdown": "Shipped on Friday."
      }
    ],
    "author": {
      "id": "u_42",
      "name": "Ada Lovelace"
    }
  }'

## Import (0.1)

POST /v1/files/{fileId}/import (operationId legacyImport)

0.1 route, kept through 0.x with its answers and `{error:{code,message}}` errors. Successor: `/api/v1/files/{fileId}/import` (sent in `Link: rel="successor-version"`, with `Deprecation`).

Parameters:
- fileId (path, string, required): The host's file id
- format (query, string, required): 
- author (query, string): 

Request body (application/octet-stream), example:
## Notes

Imported from Markdown.


Response 200 (application/json), example:
{
  "format": "md",
  "blocks": 2,
  "blockIds": [
    "b_01m87jw2k3m4n5p6q7r8s9t0v1",
    "b_01m87jw2k3w4x5y6z7a8b9c0d1"
  ],
  "live": true
}

Errors: API_KEY_INVALID (401), IMPORT_OFF (403), IMPORT_INVALID (400), IMPORT_TOO_LARGE (413), BLOCK_NOT_FOUND (404), DOC_TOO_LARGE (413), CONFLICT (409), ROOM_UNAVAILABLE (503), HOST_UNAVAILABLE (502)

Example:
curl -s -X POST "https://canvas.example.com/v1/files/doc_1/import?format=md&author=u_42" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY" \
  --data-binary @notes.md

## Convert (0.1)

POST /v1/convert (operationId legacyConvert)

0.1 route, kept through 0.x with its answers and `{error:{code,message}}` errors. Successor: `/api/v1/convert` (sent in `Link: rel="successor-version"`, with `Deprecation`).

Parameters:
- from (query, string, required): 
- to (query, string, required): 

Request body (application/octet-stream), example:
<h1>Hello</h1><p>From <strong>HTML</strong>.</p>

Response 200 (application/octet-stream), example:
# Hello

From **HTML**.


Errors: API_KEY_INVALID (401), FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED (404/400), INPUT_INVALID (400), PDF_RENDERER_NOT_CONFIGURED (501)

Example:
curl -s -X POST "https://canvas.example.com/v1/convert?from=html&to=md" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Host: acme" \
  -H "X-OpenCanvas-Key: $OC_API_KEY" \
  --data-binary @page.html \
  -o canvas.md
